title: Vision transformer predicts IDH status in diffuse glioma from MRI and radiomics
summary: vViT predicted IDH status in adult diffuse glioma; on an external test set of 291 patients (872 images) it reached accuracy 0.935 and AUC-ROC 0.887 (0.798-0.956). Enhancing-tumor radiomic features, age and sex had the highest importance. Counts are image-level with balanced classes, the study is retrospective, and the internal test set (35 patients) was predicted perfectly.
ai_technology: Variable Vision Transformer (vViT) combining sex, age, radiomic features and contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI
